+    for u, v, w in edges:

+        adj[v].append((u, w))
+        total_weight += w
+    
+    # Greedy placement: place nodes to favor cutting existing assignments
+    sides = [0] * n
+    cut_weight = 0
+    
+    for i in range(n):
+        gain_0 = 0  # weight if placed on side 0
+        gain_1 = 0  # weight if placed on side 1
+        
+        for neighbor, weight in adj[i]:
+            if sides[neighbor] == -1:  # not yet assigned
+                continue
+            if sides[neighbor] == 0:
+                gain_1 += weight  # placing on 1 cuts this edge
+            else:
+                gain_0 += weight  # placing on 0 cuts this edge
+        
+        # Place on side with greater cutting potential
+        if gain_0 >= gain_1:
+            sides[i] = 0
+        else:
+            sides[i] = 1
+    
+    # Compute initial cut weight
+    for u, v, w in edges:
+        if sides[u] != sides[v]:
+            cut_weight += w
+    
+    # One-flip local search: flip highest positive gain node until no improvement
+    max_time = start + 1.5  # Leave margin within 2s limit
+    consecutive_no_improve = 0
+    NO_IMPROVE_THRESHOLD = 10
+    
+    while time.process_time() < max_time:
+        best_flip_gain = -1
+        best_flip_node = -1
+        
+        for i in range(n):
+            gain = 0
+            for neighbor, weight in adj[i]:
+                if sides[neighbor] != sides[i]:
+                    gain -= weight  # edge currently cut, will become connected
+                else:
+                    gain += weight  # edge currently uncut, will be cut
+            
+            if best_flip_gain < gain:
+                best_flip_gain = gain
+                best_flip_node = i
+        
+        if best_flip_node >= 0 and best_flip_gain > 0:
+            sides[best_flip_node] ^= 1  # Flip side
+            cut_weight += best_flip_gain
+            consecutive_no_improve = 0
+        else:
+            consecutive_no_improve += 1
+            if consecutive_no_improve >= NO_IMPROVE_THRESHOLD:
+                # Restart from greedy placement to escape local optimum

+                    gain_1 = 0
